federation_probe.title: Federation Probe
federation_probe.desc: The federation is investigating irregularities at your club. You must act.

youth_loan.title: Ambitious Youngster
youth_loan.desc: Your best youngster wants a loan to grow. If you let them go, they return with +5 OVR.

naming_rights.title: Naming Rights
naming_rights.desc: "Patatas Lozano" offers €150,000/year to put its name on your stadium.

rival_collapse.title: Rival in Crisis
rival_collapse.desc: A direct rival is in financial trouble. Their star is available at half price.

stadium_fire.title: Stadium Fire
stadium_fire.desc: A fire damages a stand. You lose capacity or pay for repairs.
stadium_fire.optB: Play with the stand closed (-2000 capacity)

media.label: Pricey media star
media.risk: Boosts fame, but wages are huge

perfect_clone.name: Perfect Clone
perfect_clone.desc: Duplicate your best player. Two versions of the same star in your squad.

ghost_sheikh.name: Ghost Sheikh
ghost_sheikh.desc: Budget x10 for 2 seasons. When he vanishes he leaves debt, a morale drop and a temporary premium lockout.

future_scout.name: Future Scout
future_scout.desc: See real potential and mark 1 Hidden Gem per season: +5 potential and an easier wage.

fountain_of_youth.name: Fountain of Youth
fountain_of_youth.desc: All your players get 3 years younger. Permanent.

cursed_stadium.name: Cursed Stadium
cursed_stadium.desc: It always rains at home. Your team +20% performance, rival -15%. Permanent.

penalty_master.name: Penalty Master
penalty_master.desc: You never miss penalties. You win level shootouts and get +10% to score in tight games.

dr_miracles.name: Dr. Miracle
dr_miracles.desc: Injuries last 1 week max. Heal a serious injury and the player returns with +1 OVR and a relapse risk.

local_legend.name: Local Legend
local_legend.desc: Your best academy player gains +3 OVR per season instead of +1.

legal_theft.name: Legal Theft
legal_theft.desc: Each window you can sign 1 player from any team at 50% of their value.

tactical_wildcard.name: Tactical Wildcard
tactical_wildcard.desc: Unlocks secret formations (2-3-5, 3-1-3-3) with unique bonuses.

the_wall.name: The Wall
the_wall.desc: Keeper +15 OVR. If already elite, gains the Unbeatable trait and more home clean sheets.

max_speed.name: Max Speed
max_speed.desc: All forwards +10 pace, but -5 defence. Unstoppable on the counter.

diplomat.name: Diplomat
diplomat.desc: Pick a player and extend their contract by +3 years. Single use.

fame.name: Fame
fame.desc: Sponsors x2 and more players agree to join, but new contracts ask for +10% wages.

golden_academy.name: Golden Academy
golden_academy.desc: Each season a 70+ OVR academy player appears. Pure talent.

second_chance.name: Second Chance
second_chance.desc: If you lose a match, you can replay it once per season.

wild_card.name: Wild Card
wild_card.desc: At the start of each window you get a random player. Could be a star or a flop.

black_market.name: Black Market
black_market.desc: Access a secret list of 5 retired legends (85-95 OVR). You have 30 seconds to pick one. Free.

double_or_nothing.name: Double or Nothing
double_or_nothing.desc: Before each match you bet 10%, 25% or 50%. Win: double. Draw: get half back. Lose: lose it all.

achilles_heel.name: Achilles' Heel
achilles_heel.desc: Before a match, you can injure an opposing player so they cannot play.

forced_swap.name: Forced Swap
forced_swap.desc: One time only: swap one of your players for a rival of similar rating. No money.

secret_clause.name: Secret Clause
secret_clause.desc: Signings: +2 years and -30% wages, but with a low clause that may tempt big clubs.

goal_bonus.name: Money Rain
goal_bonus.desc: Every goal you score gives you a €50,000 bonus. Thrashings are very profitable.

gladiator.name: Gladiator
gladiator.desc: Your players never get red cards. Total immunity.

star_signing.name: Star Signing
star_signing.desc: Promotion roulette: pick a star veteran, a young prospect or a pricey media star. The worst player in your squad leaves.

fortaleza_maldita.name: Cursed Fortress
fortaleza_maldita.bonus: Stronghold: at home +10 extra morale, fewer injuries and more clean sheets.

cantera_infinita.name: Infinite Academy
cantera_infinita.bonus: Every 3 seasons The Wonder Kid appears, a 75-85 OVR academy player with 95 potential.

club_casino.name: Casino Club
club_casino.bonus: Chained winning bets inflate the bubble; losing two in a row triggers a tax probe.

ataque_suicida.name: Suicide Attack
ataque_suicida.bonus: More profitable thrashings: +€25,000 extra per goal if you play attacking, but exposed defence.

mercado_criminal.name: Criminal Market
mercado_criminal.bonus: Contact network: cheaper special deals, with a risk of sanction if you overdo it.

proyecto_frankenstein.name: Frankenstein Project
proyecto_frankenstein.bonus: Young clones can come out with a mutant personality: more potential or higher wages.

home_fortress.name: Unbeaten at Home
home_fortress.desc: Win 5 home matches in a row

wall.name: Defensive Wall
wall.desc: Keep 5 clean sheets in a season

negotiator.name: Negotiator
negotiator.desc: Sign 3 players in a single window

youth.name: Youth System
youth.desc: Have 3+ U21 players in your squad

trial.bannerText: Trial mode: this game is not saved in the cloud.
